idea-plugin.name: Emberkai Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Emberkai Icons brings the Symbols file and folder icon set to JetBrains IDEs, as a companion to the Emberkai theme.

Java and Kotlin declarations keep their native IntelliJ type icons and badges.

Gradle Kotlin build scripts and version catalogs use Gradle icons. Spring Boot configuration and Helm charts have context-aware icons, and Spring XML configuration uses Emberkai artwork. Spring Modulith package locks are painted onto Emberkai folders when that plugin is installed.

Includes CI pipelines (including CircleCI, Tekton, and Bazel), Ansible, infrastructure as code (including Packer, Vagrant, and Nomad), database migrations, OpenAPI and AsyncAPI contracts, Avro schemas, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Flux, Argo CD, and Skaffold, Quarkus, Micronaut, and Ktor configuration, JVM quality tooling, developer-tool configuration, and test assets.

Symbols-style project folders retain source/test colors, resource and package markers, and blue module/source-set badges, including Kotlin Multiplatform. Opt-in module-aware accents give every IntelliJ module a stable color that service roots, source roots, packages, and their descendants share. Opt-in JVM architecture folders give controller, service, repository, domain, and similar packages distinct icons.

Production, staging, test, and local variants of Spring profiles, Docker Compose files, Helm values, and .env files get shape-and-color environment badges, and so do environment folders such as overlays/production/, along with the configuration files inside them. Private keys, keystores, .env files, and similar credentials that sit in a VCS root without being ignored get a red stop-sign warning badge. Spring profile files activated by the selected run configuration get a ring-and-dot live marker. Flyway migrations that share a version with a sibling get an amber warning badge. Spring controllers, services, repositories, configuration classes, and JPA entities keep their native Java/Kotlin class icons with a small stereotype badge.

Configure everything under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Emberkai Icons with a live preview, including accessibility modes: a colorblind-friendly palette, high-contrast markers, monochrome folders, and reduced folder color. Quick toggles live in View | Emberkai Icons.

Right-click any file or folder and choose Explain This Icon to see which rule or mapping selected it. Project view tooltips describe recognized tool files, project roles, environment variants, and module accents. Run Tools | Audit Project Icon Coverage to find files that still use generic icons.

Emberkai scopes such as Emberkai: Database migrations and Emberkai: Production config use the same recognition in Find in Files, the Project view, inspections, and File Colors.

Choose a lens under View | Emberkai Icons | Lens, such as Production blast radius or Infrastructure, to keep matching files in full color and dim the rest of the Project view.

Icons by Miguel Solorio, from vscode-symbols.
